messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for staging by @maya — env=staging, ref=release/2.3.1, commit=ab12f3c, plan=canary 10% -> 100% over 15m, changewindow=now, CI=passed. tracking: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/1234 :rocket:

maya: I'll watch canary and run smoke suite once canary pods are up. ping me on regressions.

jon: @maya quick Q — should we pin the runtime image for this rollout? last week autosync bumped the node image mid-rollout.

infra-nick: Good call. Pinned canary group image to rtx-2026-03-18. command run: `kubectl -n staging set image deploy/web web=redwood/web:2.3.1-rtx` — will monitor for image pull errors.

maya: thanks. starting smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh staging ab12f3c` — will post results.

deploy-bot: Canary update: checks=1/1 pass after ~7m. Traffic shifted 10% -> 30%. monitoring: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/deploys/1769994322 :white_check_mark:

jon: Saw 95p latency +5ms vs baseline, error rate 0.1% (baseline 0.08%). within acceptable thresholds. plan to continue to 100% in 5m if stable.

maya: rolling now to 100%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 100%. Post-deploy healthchecks: OK. Rollout duration ~12m. Deployed commit ab12f3c to staging. Artifacts & logs: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/releases/2.3.1 :tada:

olivia: Nice work team. Can someone send a one-line blurb for the release notes and confirm staging is pinned for QA?

maya: one-liner: "Improve KV-cache efficiency and fix rare OOM in model runner." I'll open a tiny changelog PR in a minute.

jon: updating infra config: added `staging: pinned: release/2.3.1` in repo infra/deployments.yaml and pushed.

deploy-bot: Reminder: rollback window open for 30m. If critical issues occur, run `deploy-bot rollback --env staging --to-tag previous` or @eng-oncall to escalate. Thread closed once rollback window expires.
